entries.heading: Section 422 of division F of
ancestors: DIVISION G—DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR, ENVIRONMENT, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2022
entries.text:
Sec. 424.  Section 422 of division F of 
Public Law 110-161 (121 Stat 1844), as amended, shall be applied by 
substituting ``fiscal year 2022'' for ``fiscal year 2019''.

            interpretive association authorization extension
